title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — The Amount Claimed on a Shown-Pay Dispute
content:
**Rule.** The amount claimed on a shown-pay dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is the pay shown on the accepted offer less the pay before tips standing on the batch and less an offer tolerance of 0.50, rounded once to the cent half up and never below zero. The pay before tips standing on the batch is every pay component posted plus every pay adjustment, less every pay reversal.

## Defined quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Pay shown on the accepted offer | The pay before tips shown on the offer the shopper accepted, as recorded on the batch |
| Pay before tips standing | The total of every pay component posted on the batch, plus the total of every pay adjustment on it, less the total of every pay reversal on it; tips are not part of it |
| Offer tolerance | 0.50 |
| Amount claimed | Shown pay, less pay before tips standing, less 0.50; rounded once to the cent half up; a negative result is claimed as zero |

## Worked figures (hypothetical batch)

| Shown pay | Components posted | Adjustments | Reversals | Pay before tips standing | Amount claimed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18.00 | 16.20 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 16.20 | 18.00 less 16.20 less 0.50 gives 1.30 |
| 18.00 | 19.35 | 0.00 | 2.40 | 16.95 | 18.00 less 16.95 less 0.50 gives 0.55 |
| 14.00 | 13.80 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 13.80 | 14.00 less 13.80 less 0.50 is negative, so 0.00 |

In the second row the reversal of 2.40 lowers the pay standing, which raises the amount claimed.
